slides.h1: Strong Amatyakaraka, Long Career in a Counsel Role?
slides.sub: An illustrative look at the Jaimini minister significator.

slides.body: In Jaimini astrology, Amatyakaraka is the planet with the second-highest degree in its sign. It is the minister significator, linked to career support and advice.
Atmakaraka (highest degree planet) is the self. Amatyakaraka is the one who advises and executes for it. Strong Amatyakaraka can suit advisory, consulting or mentoring work.

points: Sign, dignity and house of Amatyakaraka
Its link to the 10th house or 10th lord
Support in D-9 and D-10 charts
Whether the running dasha activates it

slides.body: This is a pattern to explore, not a guarantee. No named chart is used here. One karaka never decides a career alone.
